reviews.text: Elaine was great!  Our pets were well cared for, and I felt assured they were in very capable hands.

I have used Elaine’s services three times and I’ve always been very happy with her services. One of my dogs needed heart meds administered twice a day and Elaine updated me throughout the day on how my dog was doing. I was very nervous leaving my dog and Elaine made me feel very relieved when she told me my dog was taking her heart meds. I highly recommend her!

Elaine watched out two cats when we were away for a week.  It was a great relief that our fur babies could stay at home rather than be housed in some small cage while we were away.  Elaine came by every day to feed them and clean their litter boxes and she played with them as well, in their own space with their own toys.  She sent us daily pictures and updates.  She is quite good with them and they made friends at our meet and greet  prior to us leaving.  We much prefer this to boarding them in a strange environment and will be calling Elaine in the future when we go away again.  Thanks Elaine!  From us and Oscar and Twiggy

UPDATE Oct 16, 2023:  Just a wee note to say Elaine of All Star Pet Sitting has continued to take care of our fur babies all this time.  And while we, Twiggy, Jock and I are still grieving the loss of our previous and special Oscar 2 years ago to an unknown illness, 💔, we are confident that Twiggy will be in loving hands with Elaine when we take our next trip. P
